name: rwaUSDi
oneLiner: rwaUSDi is Multipli's KYB-gated credit class backed by private credit, structured finance, project finance, asset-backed loans, and market-neutral funds.
collateral: Institutional, permissioned private-pool exposure with periodic pricing and scheduled, non-instant redemption. The current AFI category feed reports lithium mining, gold commodity, real estate, and copper mining exposures without identifying position-level legal instruments or named obligors.
pegMechanism: Periodic valuation of the underlying private-credit basket; KYB-gated institutional participation with scheduled redemptions. Public evidence does not establish guaranteed par redemption or whether rwaUSDi returns accrue in price, rebasing, or distributions.
